title: wiki-revert-audit: code, aggregates and logs for "Which reverts count? Successor filtering and observation windows in Wikipedia revert-based metrics"
description: Analysis pipeline, cell-level aggregates, robustness tables, figure data, preregistration text, deviation log and AI-assistance log for a preregistered measurement audit of Wikipedia revert-based metrics. The same newcomer first edits in seven language editions are held fixed while the successor filter (all reverts / excluding bots / excluding bots and tools), the observation window and the revert definition are varied. Data: Wikimedia mediawiki_history dumps, version 2026-09. Preregistration: 10.5281/zenodo.23720117.

creators.name: Jeong, Hongwon
creators.affiliation: Center for Creative Convergence Education, Hanyang University ERICA

notes: Editor-level derived data are not included because they could be re-identified from public edit histories; the code regenerates them from the dumps. Generative AI (Claude, Anthropic) assisted with drafting code and documents; see 04_logs/AI_ASSISTANCE_LOG.md.
